    protected SysMLSignal
    SysMLPort.signalFor(SysMLAnything object)
    Overridable operation to transform (encapsulate) the specified upper-level protocol object into a SysMLSignal-based signal.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "server" port that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from a "client" port for an upper-level protocol or from another SysMLPart object and encapsulates them into a SysML-based signal for transmission to a peer-level protocol port.

    protected SysMLAnything
    SysMLPort.clientObjectFor(SysMLSignal signal)
    Overridable operation to transform the object in the specified signal into a SysMLAnything-based object.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a peer-level protocol port that receives SysML-based signals from peer-level port(s) and extracts SysMLAnything-based objects from the signal for transmission to "client" ports.
    protected SysMLSignalEvent
    SysMLPort.eventFor(SysMLSignal signal)
    Overridable operation to transform the object in the specified signal into a SysMLSignalEvent-based event.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a peer-level protocol port that receives SysMLSignal-based signals from peer-level port(s) and generates SysMLSignalEvents that contain the objects contained by the signals for the eventContextPart.
